_comment: The selection walk (Joe's rulings, 2026-11-10) over candidates-2026-11-10.json: GitHub search `language:TypeScript stars:>3000 fork:false archived:false`, sort=stars, fetched with read-only `gh api` on 2026-11-10 (the survey's 2026-11-02 copy had the same order through rank 24, with older star counts). Ranks in order; the walk stopped at the 10th pick. Stars as fetched.

walk.reason: learning platform: a Gatsby browser front-end plus curriculum content; its one Node service (api/) is a MongoDB-backed server that cannot start without the database
content site (roadmaps, guides) built as an Astro/React browser front-end

walk.target: packages/util (patch engine) + packages/patchmark (markdown streaming); the CLI entry needs Bun or opencode's vite build (Solid JSX, .txt text imports), so the workload drives the two engine packages its tools and session view use
Vue 2.7 template compiler + server renderer (src/, packages/server-renderer); a framework with a Node SSR path, not a component library (judgment call, see README)
packages/workflow (n8n-workflow); the n8n server needs a database driver whose native build is an install script

walk.reason: the Node part is a scraping API server that needs Redis, Postgres and a Playwright browser service to start; the JS SDK is a network client with no offline function
Electron/browser editor; its CLI is Rust
the repo holds plugins, examples and docs, not the CLI's source
content repo (playlists); its TS scripts only regenerate that content
Bun-only (engines: bun; tools compile to Bun binaries); the product is Claude Code skills (markdown) plus a Playwright browser daemon

walk.target: packages/shadcn (the shadcn CLI), run against the repo's own apps/v4 project; the rest of the monorepo is React components and docs

walk.reason: Electron app; its CLI (out/cli) is a client of the running desktop app

walk.target: packages/agent (pi-agent-core, the agent loop); the coding-agent CLI needs model data that only its network generate step writes (packages/ai/src/providers/data/*.json)

walk.reason: the server needs Postgres and Redis, the CLI is a client of that server, the rest is a web front-end and mobile app
its worker service and storage need Bun (bun:sqlite in src/services, src/storage)
Studio (Next.js browser front-end) and docs; the platform's services live in other repos

every Node package imports packages/core/src/generated/git-commit.js, which only the build (scripts/generate-git-commit-info.js) writes, so no part runs from unmodified source; fetched and verified (sha256 in results/downloads.txt), then dropped

walk.target: apps/daemon (the od CLI); the rest is a web front-end and an Electron shell
